name: AlgMap-9.4
generalfeedback:
The objective is to get the equation into the form \({{CT:3}} = p\) where \(p\) is a rational number. To obtain \({{CT:3}}\) on one side of the equation it may be necessary to under-take several operations which must be performed on both sides of the equation. In this example:
\[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:2}}. \] We first collect like terms by moving all the constants to one side and the variables to the other (\({{CT:4}}\)): \[ {{CT:5}} = {{CT:6}}. \] Then divide by the coefficient of \({{CT:3}}\) (\({{CT:7}}\)): \[ {{CT:3}} = {{CT:8}}. \] And so we now have obtained a value for {{CT:0}}.
